description: This file is a Python source file that defines an async bot implementation using Pipecat framework, including function schemas, tool definitions, and pipeline setup for a conversational AI with weather and restaurant recommendation features.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Schema describing individual functions available to the assistant, including name, description, properties, and required fields.

classes.name: ToolsSchema
classes.description: Schema encapsulating both standard and custom tools for the assistant.

classes.name: GeminiLiveLLMService
classes.description: LLM service implementation for Gemini, supporting registration of functions and interaction.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Context object managing conversation history with roles and content.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Handles aggregation of context from user and assistant.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the conversational pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline and its parameters for execution.

classes.name: DailyParams
classes.description: Parameters specific to the 'daily' transport configuration.

classes.name: FastAPIWebsocketParams
classes.description: Parameters specific to the FastAPI WebSocket transport.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Class responsible for running and managing the pipeline execution.

methods.name: fetch_weather_from_api(params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Simulates fetching weather data based on user parameters and calls a callback with results.

methods.name: fetch_restaurant_recommendation(params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Simulates fetching a restaurant recommendation and calls a callback with result.

methods.name: end_conversation(params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Ends the conversation gracefully and signals the pipeline to finish.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Sets up and runs the entire conversational pipeline including function registration, context setup, and event handling.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main entry point to initialize the transport and start the bot.
